authorship: Original deterministic code-authored static 3D geometry, with existing Act1 painted-rock texture reuse. No new bitmap creation or edits; no source-image pixels are extracted, traced or cropped.

api.build_geometry_art: Act1MushroomGrottoArt.build_geometry_art(level: Node3D) -> Node3D. Validates all named replacement mesh leaves and stalk/base node types before creating FungalArt; returns null for an invalid level, missing required leaf or existing FungalArt.
api.integration: Owned mushroom_caverns.gd calls builder on the actual layout, retains FungalArt and requires binding_error before admission/sampling/camera forecasts.
api.set_court_open: Returned FungalArt provides set_court_open(opened: bool). This synchronous leaf toggles BlockedDrapery/OpenGatheredDrapery visibility only; starts blocked, stores court_open and emits no event.
api.process_mode: FungalArt is PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED, has no process callback, timers, tweens, particles, randomness or elapsed-time shader. Geometry and drapery states are static.
api.binding_error: Pure retained actual level/world/identity/tree, five native BOX stalk/body resources, visible bases/surfaces/caps/scenic composition, native mesh/material/renderer/texture readback and supported curtain setter checks.

palette.material: Opaque ordinary depth, unshaded, double-sided geometry, nearest texture filtering; no alpha-cutout hiding of collision, no transparent cue imitation.
palette.quiet_floor: Existing layout floor material, floor mesh, physical support and perimeter remain untouched.

physical_layout_preserved.floor_collision: Original actual floor and four perimeter collision shapes/resources/layers/masks remain. FungalArt adds no PhysicsBody3D, CollisionShape3D, Area3D or collider.
physical_layout_preserved.preserved_visible_leaves: Every GroundedBase (1.1 x 0.16 x 1.1, y 0..0.16), Floor/Visual and original perimeter visuals remain exposed.
physical_layout_preserved.replacement_method: Hide only the listed original MeshInstance3D leaves after building art. Keep their nodes and resources alive; no freeing or collision mutation.
physical_layout_preserved.transform_contract: New FungalArt root has local identity under the provided level; it uses layout-local native world-unit coordinates. Runtime validation must still verify actual level/root transforms and binding.

assets.native_scale: 1 Godot unit per frozen layout unit; no conversion or actor/camera rescaling.
assets.pivot: Each PaintedSurface root uses the frozen stalk foot-origin at y0. Cap root uses the exact frozen cap_offset.
assets.geometry: Five complete square stalk surfaces retain the visible collider footprint. Existing GroundedBase covers y0..0.16; new textured core covers y0.16..2.2. Fourteen painted grain strips per stalk. Twenty-four-sector shallow faceted caps and twenty-four radial underside gills converge at the real stalk projection.
assets.bounds: Core x/z +/-0.55. Cosmetic front/side grain projects at most 0.005 beyond the collider face. Cap/gill vertices stay inside each frozen cap_size envelope; cap world y2.32..2.48. No broadened cap or raised cluster target.
assets.collision_role: Presentation of the existing five grounded BOX colliders only. Original GroundedBase and collision nodes/resources unchanged.
assets.occlusion_role: Opaque, shallow caps can overlap distant actor quads in the fixed following camera. Actual full source/art/footprint/safe-landing framing must be reviewed after owner wiring; current component greybox views do not validate this material/art.
assets.reuse_family: E11/P12 grotto structure; intended L3 and later A1-O2 reuse, not an implemented optional-level placement.
assets.scope_limit: O44 is scenic low fungus reference only. This file does not create a hittable spore cluster, finite supply, footprint, field or release cue.
